user.title: Connect to TBD Smartshunt
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your TBD Smartshunt. Keep phone apps disconnected. Setup tests a read and attempts Bluetooth pairing if required.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Discovered TBD Smartshunt
bluetooth_confirm.description: Connect to {name}? Setup will read telemetry and attempt pairing through the selected Bluetooth adapter if required.

abort.already_configured: This TBD Smartshunt is already configured.
abort.not_supported: This advertisement does not identify a TBD Smartshunt.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the shunt. Check range, disconnect phone apps, and check the Home Assistant log.
error.pairing_failed: Automatic pairing or the authenticated read failed. Disconnect phone apps and check whether a passkey is required. See the Home Assistant log.
error.pairing_unsupported: The selected adapter does not support pairing. Check ESPHome firmware and pairing support.
error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.
